execution_contract: Recheck target absence and catalog owner immediately before any create.
One POST attempt per resource; ambiguous response reconciled by exact GET, no blind retry.
Observe full name/id/owner/type and effective inherited grants. Existing resource is not overwritten, adopted or deleted silently.
If schema creation fails, do not create volume. Never set custom storage roots.
No uploads, tables, grants, jobs, SQL, compute start or app deploy in this phase.
No rollback deletion without evaluating existing contents and separate destructive authorization.
limits: API payloads checked against installed databricks SDK0.102 generated methods; not executed.
Schema/managed volume availability does not establish table publication or permissions for app/writer.
Inherited grants and managed storage policy must be observed before loading data.
No zero-cost assertion; no compute operation in these requests.
